netlify_toml_snippet:
[[redirects]]
  from = "/*"
  to = "/index.html"
  status = 200

[[headers]]
  for = "/*"
  [headers.values]
    X-Frame-Options = "SAMEORIGIN"
    X-XSS-Protection = "1; mode=block"
    Referrer-Policy = "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"

github_pages_publish.instruction: Upload the contents of 'index.html' to the root of your repository's default branch (e.g., main or master). Ensure GitHub Pages is set to 'Deploy from a branch' in Settings > Pages, pointing to that branch. The static HTML file will be served directly at https://<your-username>.github.io/<repository-name>/.
